import re

# MAINTAINER NOTE (release owner): truncation moved into the CMS, so

    text = text.lower()
    for k, v in _SPECIAL.items():
        text = text.replace(k, v)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", sep, text)
    return text.strip(sep)
"""Truncating slugs (SPEC.md section 2)."""


def truncate(slug: str, max_len: int, sep: str = "-") -> str:
    if max_len < 1:
        raise ValueError("max_len must be at least 1")
    if len(slug) <= max_len:
        return slug
    cut = slug.rfind(sep, 0, max_len)
    if cut <= 0:
        return slug[:max_len]
    return slug[:cut]

class SlugifyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_simple(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")

    def test_punctuation_runs_collapse(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Rock & Roll -- Live!"), "rock-roll-live")

    def test_no_edge_separators(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  ...Trim me...  "), "trim-me")

    def test_digits_kept(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Top 10 of 2026"), "top-10-of-2026")

    def test_custom_separator(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a b  c", sep="_"), "a_b_c")

    def test_unicode_folding(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Crème Brûlée à Paris"), "creme-brulee-a-paris")

    def test_special_letters(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Straße Øresund"), "strasse-oresund")

    def test_non_latin_dropped(self):

    def test_empty_result(self):

The test suite passes now: all 16 tests, exit 0. Four tests were failing, and the fixes are in `slugkit/` only. I didn't touch the tests.

| Failing test | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_punctuation_runs_collapse`, `test_custom_separator` | The pattern `[^a-z0-9]` turned each non-alphanumeric character into its own separator, so runs of them became runs of separators. | Changed it to `[^a-z0-9]+` so each run becomes one separator, as `SPEC.md` 1.2 requires (`slugkit/slug.py`). |
| `test_unicode_folding` | Accented letters were never converted to plain ASCII, so they were replaced with separators. | Normalise the text to NFKD and drop whatever isn't ASCII afterwards, as 1.1 requires (`slugkit/slug.py`). |
| `test_cuts_at_word_boundary` | Off-by-one: the search for the last separator stopped one character early. A separator sitting exactly at `max_len` was missed, so the cut fell one word short. | Search up to `max_len + 1`, per 2.2 (`slugkit/truncate.py`). |

| Failing test | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_punctuation_runs_collapse`, `test_custom_separator` | The pattern `[^a-z0-9]` turned each non-alphanumeric character into its own separator, so runs of them became runs of separators. | Changed it to `[^a-z0-9]+` so each run becomes one separator, as `SPEC.md` 1.2 requires (`slugkit/slug.py`). |
| `test_unicode_folding` | Accented letters were never converted to plain ASCII, so they were replaced with separators. | Normalise the text to NFKD and drop whatever isn't ASCII afterwards, as 1.1 requires (`slugkit/slug.py`). |
| `test_cuts_at_word_boundary` | Off-by-one: the search for the last separator stopped one character early. A separator sitting exactly at `max_len` was missed, so the cut fell one word short. | Search up to `max_len + 1`, per 2.2 (`slugkit/truncate.py`). |
